thread:
opsbot: ALERT: billing.metering.counter_delta > 5% (tokens) for region=us-west between 03:24-03:33 UTC. Auto-page -> #incidents oncall. 

devon: oncall here, seeing the page. picking it up. status?

maya: flagged by wavefront, looks like token emitter lag + duplicate windowing on ingestion. customer-facing counts may be delayed/overstated.

ajay: looking at aggregator logs now. one of the k8s nodes OOM-killed aggregator-2 at 03:25, leader election moved shards -> backlog. replay job still running.

sara: any immediate customer impact? seeing a few overage flags for 3 customers in the alerts dashboard. they got emails.

devon: thanks. can we stop replay temporarily to avoid duplicates while we reconcile?

ajay: agree. pausing replay for shard 7-9. command: ``kubectl -n metering scale deployment/replay-worker --replicas=0``

billing-sre: note — if we pause replay we'll undercount some late tokens. tradeoff: short-term duplicate overcounts vs delayed undercounts. recommend pause + fallback to shadow-agg for realtime billing checks.

maya: +1 to shadow-agg routing. switching inference pipeline to shadow-agg for the next 15m. doing the route flip: ``/api/route?target=shadow-agg&duration=15m``

opsbot: INCIDENT NOTE: manual intervention set by @maya at 03:28 UTC.

devon: restarted aggregator-2, monitoring JVM heap, raised replica memory to 6Gi. restart logs: ```INFO Restarted aggregator-2 (pid 4123)\nINFO Recovered 12 windows in backlog\nWARN High KV TTL pressure```

ajay: backlog drain rate picked up after restart, duplicates spiked briefly because replay and recovery overlapped. paused replay at 03:29, now resume with dedupe flag off.

sara: outreach update: support sent manual emails to affected customers saying "possible transient overage flags; we are investigating; billing will be reconciled automatically". sent to acct team for follow-up.

billing-sre: running a quick SQL check to detect duplicate windows: ``SELECT count(*) FROM token_windows WHERE window_id IN (SELECT window_id FROM replay_log GROUP BY window_id HAVING count(*)>1);``

devon: result: 47 duplicate windows in last 10m. running dedupe cleanup script now.``./scripts/dedupe_windows --window-age=15m``

maya: after dedupe and route flip, charge flags in dashboard dropped to baseline at 03:33. continuing to monitor for 30m.

opsbot: RESOLVE CHECK: metric token_delta back to <1% after mitigation window. please add postmortem notes in #postmortems with timeline + followups (auto-reminder in 2h). :white_check_mark:

ajay: followups: add liveness probe changes to replay-worker, increase leader election timeout, and add metric to detect overlapping replay+recovery.

devon: assigning owner for followups: ajay (replay-worker), maya (routing fallback playbook), billing-sre (customer reconciliation script).

sara: noting customer list for reconciliation: acct-123, acct-789, acct-456. will confirm once cleanup completes.

billing-sre: adding a safeguard: if duplicate windows > 10 within 10m, auto-suspend replay and notify oncall. PR incoming.

devon: thanks team. closing live triage. will keep an eye until 04:00 UTC.
